title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: graph connector prompts in the Prompt Gallery for Copilot Chat
summary: Hold: the briefing treats unchanged connector reach as established, although Microsoft documents permission filtering rather than the new prompts' data-access mechanism. It also extends the documented AI Administrator deployment role to connector governance, for which the federated connector management page specifies different roles.
